summary.name: Text With History
summary.one_liner: An AI chatbot app where users converse with AI personas of historical figures and study-focused history tutors.
keywords: text to speech historical figure voice
use_cases: Chatting with historical figures for learning
Learning about events that happened on this day
Hearing historical figures' messages as voicemails
Studying history across eras and cultures
summary.what_it_does: Text With History lets users chat with AI personas of historical figures such as Cleopatra, Abraham Lincoln and Marie Curie, with a large list of others said to be included. Figures can send Voicemails, which are spoken messages in each figure's distinct voice, and users can also convert existing text replies into Voicemails. A "Today in History" feature covers events from this date, and "Study Tutors" are professor personas for specialized areas such as ancient, medieval, modern, cultural history and the Renaissance. The page says responses are based on publicly available data and records, and recommends double-checking them. Premium subscribers get unlimited access, advanced reasoning, ad-free use, threads and longer messages.
notable: Voicemails: figures leave spoken messages in their own distinct voice
Study tutor personas for specialized history topics
Supports over 100 languages for chat, with interface in 11 languages
Per-figure memory of facts about the user, which can be erased
caveats: Full range of figures and unlimited messaging require a premium subscription
Voicemail credits are limited: 30 per month for premium, with extra credit packs purchasable
Mac app does not yet support thread syncing; web app recommended on Mac for that
